rows.quote: The primary set originated from the FinnGen consortium (release R10), comprising 6340 cases and 314,193 controls for LC, along with subtypes: LUAD (1590 cases), LUSC (1510 cases), and SCLC (717 cases), each with 314,193 controls.[21,22] Replication relied on the TRICL-ILCCO meta-analysis, including 29,266 cases and 56,450 controls for LC, with subtypes: LUAD (11,273 cases, 55,483 controls), LUSC (7426 cases, 55,627 controls), and SCLC (2664 cases, 21,444 controls).[23] All analyses utilized publicly available GWAS summary statistics from European-ancestry populations, with details summarized in Table 1.
rows.coder_note: Sentence writes 'FinnGen consortium (release R10)'; the endpoint case and control counts are endpoint-specific and not a conflict (rule H).
